slug: 2025-06-30 Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act - Overview

facts.fact: Michalsons states the Act is enforced by POTRAZ, which also maintains a public register of automated data processing; dated by publication.
Michalsons describes the Cyber and Data Protection Act, 2021 as Zimbabwe's main data protection law applying to all public and private organisations; dated by publication.
Michalsons states the Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers Regulations came into force on 12 September 2024.
facts.system: Cyber and Data Protection (Licensing of Data Controllers and Appointment of Data Protection Officers) Regulations, 2024 (SI 155 of 2024)
